  "title": "DNS leak?",
  "body": "Some of our users showed concern about their system's resolver leaking DNS queries when checking trackers, etc. We should investigate it.",
  "author": "Participant 1",
  "created_at": "2020-04-01T10:56:11Z",
  "updated_at": "2020-10-17T10:14:59Z",
  "state": "closed",
  "closed_at": null,
  "issue_fetched_at": "2026-11-05T07:22:02.181611+00:00",
  "comments_fetched_at": [
    "2026-11-05T07:22:02.181611+00:00"
  ],
  "expected_comment_count": 9,
  "retrieved_comment_count": 9,
  "comments_complete": true,
  "comments": [
    {
      "id": 607181002,
      "url": "https://github.com/Tribler/tribler/issues/5262#issuecomment-607181002",
      "created_at": "2020-04-01T10:58:14Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "Isn't this fixed in 7.5?"
    },
    {
      "id": 607184569,
      "url": "https://github.com/Tribler/tribler/issues/5262#issuecomment-607184569",
      "created_at": "2020-04-01T11:07:00Z",
      "updated_at": "2020-04-01T11:07:14Z",
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "DHT leak is fixed in 7.5. This one is talking about DNS hostnames for trackers, which are served by the system's resolver."
    },
    {
      "id": 607188058,
      "url": "https://github.com/Tribler/tribler/issues/5262#issuecomment-607188058",
      "created_at": "2020-04-01T11:15:24Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "Oh my bad, I thought that was also anonymized now."
    },
    {
      "id": 607189096,
      "url": "https://github.com/Tribler/tribler/issues/5262#issuecomment-607189096",
      "created_at": "2020-04-01T11:17:58Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "Torrent checking is not anonymous, only `DownloadManager.get_metainfo` is."
    },
    {
      "id": 607190635,
      "url": "https://github.com/Tribler/tribler/issues/5262#issuecomment-607190635",
      "created_at": "2020-04-01T11:21:36Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "Should we create a feature to only use anonymized DHT lookups?"
    },
    {
      "id": 607193317,
      "url": "https://github.com/Tribler/tribler/issues/5262#issuecomment-607193317",
      "created_at": "2020-04-01T11:27:53Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "DHT lookups all rely on `get_metainfo`, so they shouldn't leak. To fix any leakage in `TorrentChecker`, we need to allow it to use a SOCKS5 proxy, and also allow TCP scrape requests in the `TunnelCommunity`."
    },
    {
      "id": 607196743,
      "url": "https://github.com/Tribler/tribler/issues/5262#issuecomment-607196743",
      "created_at": "2020-04-01T11:35:40Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 2",
      "body": "> To fix any leakage in TorrentChecker, we need to allow it to use a SOCKS5 proxy, and also allow TCP scrape requests in the TunnelCommunity.\r\n\r\nSeems like a reasonable feature for `7.6` to me."
    },
    {
      "id": 607212301,
      "url": "https://github.com/Tribler/tribler/issues/5262#issuecomment-607212301",
      "created_at": "2020-04-01T12:12:09Z",
      "updated_at": "2020-04-01T12:21:29Z",
      "author": "Participant 3",
      "body": "I was thinking that maybe we should just allow all HTTP requests that have a bencoded response. This would automatically allow both scrape and announce requests to TCP trackers while avoiding tracker specific logic/messages in the `TunnelCommunity`."
    },
    {
      "id": 607230873,
      "url": "https://github.com/Tribler/tribler/issues/5262#issuecomment-607230873",
      "created_at": "2020-04-01T12:52:38Z",
      "updated_at": null,
      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "@egbertbouman , sounds like a (relatively) simple and robust solution."
    }
  ],
